1. (Currently Amended) A method of cementing comprising: providing a cement composition comprising a carboxylated inulin and an additional component selected from the group consisting of a borate salt, an organic acid comprising an alpha-hydroxycarboxylic acid, or a synthetic polymer comprising a carboxylate group; and allowing the cement composition to set.

2. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition has a thickening time of from about 2 hours to about 11 hours at temperatures up to about 280 *F.

3. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein a viscosity of the cement composition is about constant for a period of time after the cement composition is placed.

4. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein a suspension aid is not added to the cement composition.

5. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition has a free water separation of from about 0.0 to about 2 wt.% of the cement composition.

6. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the carboxylated inulin is derived from an inulin having an average molecular weight of about 500 or higher.

7. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the carboxylated inulin comprises carboxymethylated inulin.

8. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 7 wherein the carboxymethylated inulin has a degree of substitution by carboxymethylated of from about 0.1 to about 0.3.

9. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition comprises from about 0.1 to about 5 wt. % of carboxylated inulin.

10. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition is placed in a subterranean formation.

11. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition is placed in a wellbore.

12. (Currently Amended) A method of cementing in a subterranean formation comprising: providing a cement composition comprising a carboxylated inulin and an additional component selected from the group consisting of a borate salt, an organic acid comprising an alpha-hydroxycarboxylic acid, or a synthetic polymer comprising a carboxylate group; placing the cement composition in the subterranean formation; and allowing the cement composition to set therein.

13. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 12 wherein the cement composition has a thickening time of from about 2 hours to about 11 hours at temperatures up to about 280 *F.

14. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 12 wherein a viscosity of the cement composition is about constant for a period of time after the cement composition is placed.

15. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 12 wherein a suspension aid is not added to the cement composition.

16. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 12 wherein the cement composition has a free water separation of from about 0.0 to about 2 wt.% of the cement composition.

17. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 12 wherein the carboxylated inulin is derived from an inulin having an average molecular weight of about 500 or higher.

18. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 12 wherein the carboxylated inulin comprises carboxymethylated inulin.

19. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 18 wherein the carboxymethylated inulin has a degree of substitution by carboxymethylated of from about 0.1 to about 0.3.

20. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 12 wherein the cement composition comprises from about 0.1 to about 5 wt. % of carboxylated inulin.

21. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 12 wherein the cement composition is placed in a wellbore.
